review_candidates.title: Senior Electrical Engineer
review_candidates.location: Qesm El Obour, Al Qalyubiyah, Egypt
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Troubleshooting Automation Systems: Diagnose and troubleshoot control circuits, PLC, HMI, VFDs, sensors, and actuators. Control & Distribution Panels Maintenance: Inspect and maintain control panels, main distribution boards (PCC), and Motor Control Centers (MCC). PLC Programming & Troubleshooting: Perform PLC programming, troubleshooting, and program backup/upload/download when required. VFD & Soft Starter Maintenance: Monitor and maintain Variable Frequency Drives (VFD/Inverters), Soft Starter
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: PLC Expertise: Hands-on experience with PLCs, particularly Siemens, Delta, or equivalent industrial automation systems. Drives & Motor Protection: Proficient in VFDs/Inverters, Soft Starters, motor control circuits, and electrical protection devices.
